column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
a comment is not a command
a commit message in a here-document is not read as a command
a here-document written to a file nothing runs is data
a message quoted in pieces round an apostrophe is still a message
a message that starts with a variable is not taken for a path
a payload piped into a shell handed a script file is data to that script
a quoted argument naming a denied command is data
a quoted here-document word leaves the body unexpanded, so it is data
a row no longer runs across a line break into the next command
a sed script that starts with a slash is not taken for a path
nor is one in the $(cat <<EOF) form of Claude Code's commit template
